features: [5MP+5MP DUAL LENS WITH DUAL LIVE VIEW]: Experience enhanced monitoring with a powerful 5MP PTZ lens and a 5MP fixed wide-angle lens that display two live views simultaneously. Monitor multiple areas at once while reducing blind spots, making it ideal for homes, shops, offices and warehouses.

[360° PTZ COVERAGE WITH AI HUMAN DETECTION]: Control the PTZ camera remotely through the mobile app to pan and tilt across a wide area. Advanced AI Human Detection intelligently identifies people, sends instant motion alerts and helps you stay informed about important activity around your property.

[FULL COLOR NIGHT VISION FOR 24×7 SECURITY]: Built-in white LEDs and infrared LEDs help deliver bright, colorful and detailed surveillance even in low-light conditions. Monitor entrances, parking areas, gardens and indoor spaces with improved visibility during both day and night.

[2-WAY AUDIO & REMOTE APP ACCESS]: Built-in microphone and speaker allow you to listen and talk through the camera using the mobile app. View live footage, receive notifications, control PTZ movement and manage camera settings remotely from anywhere with an internet connection.

[EASY 2.4GHz WIFI SETUP & SMART STORAGE]: Connect quickly to your 2.4GHz WiFi network using the mobile app for hassle-free installation without complicated wiring. Supports microSD cards up to 128GB (sold separately) and compatible cloud storage options, making it a convenient security solution for everyday monitoring.

[5MP+5MP DUAL LENS DUAL VIEW MONITORING]: Features a high-definition 5MP PTZ lens together with a 5MP fixed lens, allowing you to monitor two different views simultaneously. The combination helps provide wider coverage while keeping important areas under continuous observation.

[360° PTZ CONTROL WITH FIXED VIEW]: Remotely pan and tilt the PTZ camera through the mobile app while the fixed lens continuously monitors a selected area. This dual-view design helps reduce blind spots around your home, office, shop or warehouse.

[AI HUMAN MOTION DETECTION & COLOR NIGHT VISION]: AI-powered human detection helps identify people and sends instant motion alerts to your smartphone. Full-color night vision helps deliver brighter and clearer surveillance in low-light conditions for improved day and night monitoring.

[TWO-WAY AUDIO & REMOTE APP ACCESS]: Built-in microphone and speaker allow you to listen and talk through the camera using the mobile app. View live footage, receive alerts and control camera functions remotely from anywhere using a compatible internet connection.

[WIFI CONNECTIVITY & MULTIPLE STORAGE OPTIONS]: Connect easily to your 2.4GHz WiFi network for quick installation without complicated wiring. Supports microSD card storage (up to 128GB, sold separately) and compatible cloud storage services, making it suitable for homes, shops, offices and small businesses.
